arch-control.name: Control
arch-control.description: Answers the rival's Units one by one with removal and bottom-deck effects, denies Gigs, and draws cards to keep up. Gives up early ground, then stabilizes and wins late on a cleared board.

arch-tempo.name: Tempo
arch-tempo.description: Uses cheap interaction (spending rival Units, power shrink, bottom-deck, adjusting Gigs) to disrupt the rival's turn so they never develop, while a few efficient threats keep attacking.

arch-midrange.name: Midrange
arch-midrange.description: Efficient mid-cost Units backed by Gear and a little removal. Flexible: plays tempo against slow decks and defends against fast ones, and wins fights on the board before attacking for Gigs.

arch-gear.name: Gear / Equip
arch-gear.description: Loads cheap Gear onto sturdy Units or Legends to win fights and attack through the board, drawing extra cards off Gear triggers. Gear count is high relative to Units.

misc-competitive.name: Competitive
misc-competitive.description: Tuned and tested for tournament play.

misc-featured.name: Featured
misc-featured.description: Shown in the big Featured spot at the top of the website's Decks page.

misc-casual.name: Casual / Fun
misc-casual.description: Built for fun and theme rather than raw power.
